violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Drop gates, if present fasten securely and cannot be opened by a child (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(8))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Drop gates, if present fasten securely and cannot be opened by a child
violation_type.typical_finding: A child was placed in a crib that did not have a safely secured drop down gate, causing the child to fall out.

finding_variants.text: A child was placed in a crib that did not have a safely secured drop down gate, causing the child to fall out.

It was determined throughout the course of the HHS Investigation that a caregiver left the side drop gate down on a crib and walked away from the crib while the infant was awake.  This was confirmed through reviewing surveillance footage.
Based on the information obtained standard was found non-compliance.
